summary: ITER 48 — Backend testing for (1) Ambassador Incentive Programme (R8500 ZAR), (2) Global Admin Job Applications, (3) Super Admin User Cleanup. 27/27 backend tests PASS end-to-end against the public ingress URL. Frontend: source-verified all data-testids present (incentive-available/activity-targets/tiers/withdraw-section, admin-job-applications-page+status-pill/app-row/btn-view/btn-hired/btn-reject, owner-user-cleanup-page+cleanup-row/cleanup-delete/cleanup-confirm-modal/cleanup-reason/cleanup-confirm-email/cleanup-confirm, users-cleanup+users-job-apps tiles). All 3 new routes (/ambassadors/me, /admin/job-applications, /admin/owner/cleanup) render the React tree without errors. Live click-test still blocked by the auth-bootstrap issue carried over from iter35/iter36 (JWT injected via localStorage doesn't hydrate AuthContext). Coverage: GET /admin/ambassador/config returns spec defaults exactly (starting=8500, referral_pot=5000, activity_pot=3500, tiers=[20,40,60,80,100], first=500, percent=20, min_score=1000, targets={posts:20,likes:100,ad_shares:5}); standard admin gets 403; PATCH with invalid keys → 400. POST /admin/users/{id}/make-ambassador allocates 8500 exactly once (audit row created); second call leaves both balance AND tampered ambassador_paid_zar untouched (true idempotency, single audit doc). PATCH /admin/users/{id}/role {role:'ambassador'} also allocates 8500. GET /ambassador/incentive: non-ambassador → is_ambassador=false; ambassador with currency=ZAR → starting=8500, available=5000, activity_pot locked, tier_referrals_required=[20,40,60,80,100], june_payout_locked=true, eligible_to_withdraw=false, display.currency=ZAR/symbol=R/rate=1; with currency=USD → display.currency=USD and display.available scaled down (USD/ZAR FX applied). POST /ambassador/incentive/withdraw: non-ambassador → 403 (june lock fires first which is fine); ambassador pre-cutoff → 403 with 'june' message — INTENDED behavior per spec. Activity unlock: seeded 20 posts (user_id) + 100 posts with likes:[uid] + 5 ad_reward_claims with event_kind:'share' — GET /ambassador/incentive returns activity_progress counts of 20/100/5 (helper _count_ambassador_activity correctly counts via posts.likes array, not post_reactions). GET /admin/job-applications returns rows[] + counts{all,new,shortlisted,interview,hired,rejected}; plain user → 403. POST /admin/job-applications/{id}/view first call → already_viewed=false; second call → already_viewed=true (idempotent — no re-email). PATCH /admin/job-applications/{id} updates status and persists in mongo; invalid status → 400/422. GET /admin/users/cleanup-candidates (super_admin) returns rows with posts_count+jobs_count+stokvels_count+is_stale; standard admin → 403; no admin/super_admin/owner-email rows in list. POST /admin/users/cleanup-delete: short reason → 400; email mismatch → 400; wallet_balance_usd>0 → 400; targeting admin → 403; targeting platform owner → 403; standard admin caller → 403; happy path → 200 with deletions{users:1} and user/posts both gone from mongo.

minor.issue: Activity unlock helper (_check_ambassador_activity_unlock) is only invoked from post-create / react / share-ad write paths (server.py L1889/3223/3415). GET /ambassador/incentive does NOT trigger the unlock check — so if activity counts cross the threshold via background data import or direct DB writes, the flag stays false until the next post/like/share event. Consider also calling the helper on the GET endpoint (cheap idempotent call) so users see the unlock the moment they hit the dashboard.

integration_issues.issue: Same auth-bootstrap blocker as iter35/36 — minted JWT in localStorage does not hydrate the React AuthContext through Playwright. Source-level data-testid verification done. Main agent should self-verify the live UI in an authenticated browser session.

action_items: (Optional product UX) Call _check_ambassador_activity_unlock(user_id) inside GET /ambassador/incentive so the unlock surfaces immediately on dashboard load even if the user has not just posted/liked/shared.

(Carry-over from iter36, still UNFIXED) server.py L7919 PUT /admin/feature-flags/{key} — change `if admin.get('role') != 'admin'` to `if admin.get('role') not in ('admin','super_admin')`. Not retested this iteration but still flagged.
(Carry-over from iter35) server.py L2842 create_post uses `current_user['photo']` — KeyError risk on legacy users; switch to `.get('photo','')`.
(Carry-over) server.py promotion notifier still uses `async for uid in db.promotion_events.distinct(...)` which is broken — distinct returns a List, not async-iterable.

Live UI retest in an authenticated browser session — main agent or next testing iter should manually click through /ambassadors/me + /admin/job-applications + /admin/owner/cleanup with the real OTP-verified standing admin to verify visual layout + the cleanup-confirm-modal validation copy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has DUPLICATE definitions of require_admin_user (L6367 + L7306) and require_super_admin (L6375 + L7314). Both bodies are identical and Python keeps the last-assigned binding, so runtime is correct, but this is a footgun — a future edit to only one copy will silently diverge. Consolidate to a single definition near the top of the auth section and delete the dupe.

server.py L11267 wallet-balance check: `if target.get('wallet_balance_usd') and float(target.get('wallet_balance_usd') or 0) > 0` will incorrectly accept a wallet_balance_usd of `0.001` from a falsy-evaluation perspective (0 is falsy but a positive float is truthy, so OK) — but it will also short-circuit-skip the float() check for a value like `'0'` (string '0' is truthy → falls through). Recommend `try: bal = float(target.get('wallet_balance_usd') or 0); except: bal = 0; if bal > 0: ...`.

server.py L11237 cleanup-candidates is_stale computation uses naive string compare (`last_login < cutoff`) where both sides are ISO 8601 — works only if all timestamps include the same offset (UTC 'Z' or '+00:00'). Mixed-offset data in the wild would mis-sort. Switch to parsing with datetime.fromisoformat() before comparing.

server.py L6431 `_count_ambassador_activity` likes-count via `db.posts.count_documents({'likes': user_id})` has no created_at filter and no upper bound. An ambassador who liked thousands of posts pre-grant will trivially hit the unlock target — confirm with product whether 'likes given since grant' is really the spec (current behavior credits all-time likes).

server.py L11247 cleanup-delete iterates a hardcoded list of 21 collections — easy to fall out of sync as new collections get added. Consider a registry-driven approach or at least a doc-comment listing every user-foreign-key collection that must stay in sync.
Frontend AdminJobApplicationsPage.js + OwnerUserCleanupPage.js + IncentivePanel: confirmed via source grep that all 16 required data-testids from the spec are present. No missing testids.

rca_of_the_issue: No new bugs found in iter48. All three feature areas (Ambassador Incentive, Global Job Applications, User Cleanup) behave per spec. The only behavioral observation worth a UX tweak: activity-unlock only fires on write events (post/react/share), not on dashboard GET — so seed/import data flows won't surface the unlock until the next live action.
